Available only where benchmarking is enabled (`BENCHMARK_QDRANT_COLLECTION` and `BENCHMARK_ROOT` set; dev only), otherwise `404`. post.description: Search for text passages answering a natural language question, with LLM assistance. An LLM first extracts the text request from the question (time-period, location and language constraints are extracted but not yet applied). The index is searched with that request, and the LLM then scores each candidate and drops those scoring below 3, so fewer than `k` results may be returned. If either LLM step fails, the original question and the unreranked results are used instead. Dataset access filtering is the same as `POST /search/`. Results also carry the item `metadata`.

post.description: Indexes a dataset described by a dataset profile (JSON) that the service reads from `path_to_profile` (a path on the service's mounted storage, e.g. `/s3/...`). The caller needs a `dg_ds-edit` grant on the profile's `@id` or a privileged role. Ingestion runs as a background job: the endpoint returns `202` with a `job_id` to poll via `GET /ingest/{job_id}`. The job record is saved before the job starts; if it cannot be saved, the request fails with `424`. If the dataset is already indexed and `replace` is false, nothing is done and `200` with status `skipped` is returned.

post.description: Same search as `POST /search/`, but the request and response are DataGEMS analytical patterns. The search arguments are read from the `properties` of the node labelled `CDD_Operator`. In the response, any nodes previously connected as outputs of the operator are removed; one `sc:Dataset` node is added per result dataset and one `cr:FileObject` node per result object, with an `output` edge from the operator and a `distribution` edge from the dataset to each object. The full search response is merged into the pattern's `metadata`. A pattern without a `CDD_Operator` node, without `query`, or with invalid optional arguments results in a 500 error.

post.description: Submits a natural language query and returns a ranked list of relevant results. The search can be restricted to `dataset_ids`; this list is intersected with the datasets the caller holds a `dg_ds-browse` grant on, and results from any other dataset are always dropped. Callers with a privileged role (`dg_admin`, `dg_system`, `dg_dataset-curator`) are not filtered. If none of the requested datasets are permitted, an empty result list is returned.

post.description: Re-indexes the dataset-level metadata of an already-indexed dataset from its profile, without re-ingesting its files. Today the dataset `description` is the only dataset-level metadata that is indexed, so only its point is replaced. The caller needs a `dg_ds-edit` grant on the profile's `@id` or a privileged role. The new point is written before the old ones are deleted, so the dataset stays searchable throughout. Content indexed from the dataset's files is not touched; when the files have changed, use `POST /ingest/` with `replace=true`.
